newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen remaining strong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen remaining strong.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain strong this week, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly report.

The eastern market indicator last week rose by 11 cents to 575 cents a kg clean, while the western market indicator rose 10 cents to 535 cents a kg. Sales this week are in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with a total of 73,031 bales on offer.
Wesfarmers said prices are expected to remain strong due to a smaller national offering of medium types, partly due to growers withdrawing wool prior to sale in anticipation of a firmer market.
Prices should also be supported by improved buyer confidence as they buy stock to cover previously sold positions, stimulating price competition, Wesfarmers said.
"The finer end of the market is expected to be firm," it said.

Wesfarmers said Geelong has a large selection of fine wools, mostly of smiliar style and for upward price movement, this market requires substantial European demand which has been relatively lacklustre, despite good competition for top quality clips.
